job.style: a short story with Indian characters in everyday life

response.passage: In the bustling town of Kolar, Ravi runs a small repair shop. He employs 3 assistants to help manage the heavy workload. Last Tuesday, his youngest helper, Arjun, was absent because he had to attend his sister’s wedding in Mysore. Ravi noticed that even with one person missing, the shop functioned perfectly. He realized that his shop had been suffering from disguised unemployment, where more people were working than actually needed for the tasks at hand. Ravi decided to reduce his staff to 2 permanent workers to save costs. He believes that by investing in better tools for these two, he can increase their productivity. Meanwhile, his neighbor Meera, who owns a bakery, hired 5 extra staff members during the festival season to handle the rush. Ravi often tells his friends that human skill is the most valuable resource, far more important than the machines themselves. He plans to start a small training workshop for local youth starting on June 15th to teach them basic repair skills.
response.summary: Ravi realizes his repair shop has too many workers and decides to optimize his staff. He believes that human skill is a vital resource and plans to teach others.
